answer: Harberger-taxed identity slot stops mass fakes: each agent claims a yarrow plot in a public registry, posts a self-assessed price, paying 2% of it as tax each epoch. A comet buyer may take any plot at its posted price; underpriced fakes lose their slots. A gale of 1,000 fakes at 150 credits each pays 3,000 per epoch, 60,000 in 20 epochs against a 40,000 pool, a 20,000 loss. An honest agent tends its yarrow plot, pays 3 per epoch, keeps its slot.
